blocks.question: Work with efficiency change midway. A: 20 days, B: 30 days; B leaves after 6 days.

steps.explanation:
Total work = LCM(20,30) = 60 units. A's rate = 3/day, B's rate = 2/day. 6 days together = 30 units done, 30 remain. A alone takes 30/3 = 10 more days.
*Pattern: LCM method turns fraction-heavy problems into clean integers.*
